title: The Andhra Pradesh Residential and Non-Residential Premises Tenancy Act, 2017
currency_note: India Code records Act No. 10 of 2018 and does not mark it repealed. Section 1(3) says commencement requires an Andhra Pradesh Gazette notification. No authoritative commencement notification or rules were located in this acquisition pass, so the Act must not be represented as fully operative until that evidence is attached. A 2024 Andhra Pradesh Vidyut Ombudsman order refers to section 20 as the present law; that is supporting evidence, not a substitute for the commencement notification.
validation_note: Official India Code English text. The 26-page PDF is structurally valid, text-extractable, and passed first-page visual inspection. Preserve COMMENCEMENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED through promotion.
